answer: Attackers forging thousands of identities face escalating puzzle difficulty, like a zephyr widening into a canyon of cost, while honest peers float on a reef of shared stake and reputation that fake clusters cannot cheaply replicate. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity bonding: each agent must burn compute on a unique epoch puzzle, and registration requires a bond locked against attested behavior. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
